dedupe_keys.name: zinwa dam levels water intelligence platform zimbabwe

description: The Zimbabwe National Water Authority publishes a Dam Levels page, presented as a water intelligence platform, with weekly storage data for the country's dams. The snapshot read was dated 23 September 2026 and covered 152 dams with an average of 85.2 per cent and a national storage level of 85.4 per cent, down 0.59 per cent since 16 September 2026. The page flags dams below 50 per cent storage and full dams, gives an analysis by seven catchments, and has a dam explorer that filters by catchment, storage status (critical under 50 per cent, 50 to 79.9, 80 to 99.8, full) and purpose, and sorts by name, storage and largest weekly rise or fall. A print or save-as-PDF option is offered. Access is free with no registration; no licence is stated and no bulk download or API was seen on the page read. Caveats: only the latest snapshot is shown, historical series are not offered, and capacities and coordinates of the dams were not seen. Coverage is Zimbabwe. It supports drought and water supply analysis for reservoirs that feed urban water, irrigation and hydropower; related records are SIAGUAPY of Paraguay and the DINAGUA water level data of Uruguay.
